title: His beaver is up.
html_source: The “beaver” is the front part of a helmet, which could be raised to reveal the face. In Hamlet, Horatio informs Hamlet of what he has seen and de- scribes the Ghost as armed from head to foot. “HAMLET:Then saw you not his face?HORATIO: o, yes, my lord; he wore his beaver up” (I.ii.229-30).
